messages:
Maria Chen: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need owners + dates for vendor/dependency mitigations (cloud provider CDN, model-registry auth). Keep items timeboxed.
Kenji Sato: I'll own model-registry auth fallback. Deliverable: health-probe + read-only replica switch + dry-run plan. Due 2026-04-05.
Samir Gupta: I'll own the recurring-patterns summary and SLI definitions. Due 2026-04-03. Please each add one pattern to the tracker.
Elaine Park: I'll own vendor SLA/contact updates and PagerDuty aliases. Due 2026-04-07.
Kenji Sato: Adding a simple failure-inject script to the runbook for dry-runs: `for i in {1..30}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer BAD" https://model-registry.internal/api/v1/models; sleep 0.2; done`
ops-bot: :robot_face: Task created: toggle-readonly-replica assigned to eng-infra. Ticket INF-4908. ETA: 2 business days.
Maria Chen: Preference: manual toggle first, then consider automated circuit-breaker. Keep incident actions <= 2 weeks. Projects (auth redesign) go to planning board.
Samir Gupta: I'll monitor telemetry for the dry-run. Also request: add SLI for registry-read P95 when fallback active.
Kenji Sato: Will add SLI and checklist to the runbook card.
incident-bot: Follow-up meeting scheduled: Vendor-dep mitigations review — 2026-04-02 15:00 UTC. Invite sent.
Maria Chen: Thanks. Everyone drop owner/due/acceptance into the tracker now so I can close the loop.
